mapper.select: select u.user_id as userId,u.user_name as userName from sys_config c join sys_user u on cast(c.config_value as unsigned)=u.user_id where c.config_key='lab.system.operator-user-id' and u.status='1' and u.del_flag='0' and u.user_name='__lab_system_operator__' and not exists(select 1 from sys_user_role ur where ur.user_id=u.user_id) and not exists(select 1 from sys_user_post up where up.user_id=u.user_id) limit 1
